title: VDCores Qwen3-8B Decode Preflight

workload.input_policy: vdcores_offline_decode prompt policy: target 128 prompt tokens; the current source preflight uses the hard-coded Qwen token IDs from cli.py until the batch-ladder harness is added.
workload.output_policy: vdcores_offline_decode output policy: 64 decode tokens for final paper rows; the current preflight uses --correctness to validate model load and launcher operator coverage first.
workload.batch_or_concurrency: offline fixed batch target sizes 1,2,4,8,16; current Qwen3-8B source path fixes REQ=N=8 internally and needs a paper harness before importing batch-ladder rows.

model_access.why: Qwen/Qwen3-8B is public and the H200 preflight loaded it from the offline cache. The VDCores runtime_context.py still indexes os.environ["HF_TOKEN"], so run_commands set HF_TOKEN= as an environment key, not as gated authentication.

setup_commands: cd tmp/baselines/vdcores && CPATH=<cutlass>/include DAE_COMPUTE_OPS_FILE=<artifact>/qwen3-8b-compute-ops.vdcore.build make clean pyext NVCC_FLAGS="-O3 -Iinclude/dae -Iinclude -Ibuild/generated -I<cutlass>/include -std=c++20 -Xptxas=-v -use_fast_math -lineinfo -DNDEBUG -include cfloat"
run_commands: cd tmp/baselines/vdcores && HF_TOKEN= HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python app/python/qwen3/sched.py --hf-cache-dir <shared-hf-cache>/hub --correctness
cd tmp/baselines/vdcores && DAE_BENCH_WARMUP=1 HF_TOKEN= HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python app/python/qwen3/sched.py --hf-cache-dir <shared-hf-cache>/hub -N 1 -b 5

cd tmp/baselines/vdcores && DAE_BENCH_WARMUP=1 HF_TOKEN= HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python app/python/qwen3/sched.py --hf-cache-dir <shared-hf-cache>/hub -N 64 -b 5

import_target.notes: Do not import as a result until correctness passes. Current evidence shows Qwen3-8B model load, operator rebuild, token-1 correctness, 64-token capacity measurement, and a global-instruction timing variant that fails correctness.
